test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number and symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) 4 T 6 $ 2 A D & C E 2 4 + & 7 6 U 5 H U K 8 E W @ E A & P (Right)

If all the letters are dropped from the series, which of the following will be tenth from the left?
solution:
Given terms: (Left) 4 T 6 $ 2 A D & C E 2 4 + & 7 6 U 5 H U K 8 E W @ E A & P (Right)

If all the letters are dropped from the series then the arrangements are:

(Left) 4 6 $ 2 & 2 4 + & 7 6 5 8 @ & (Right)

Here,

Tenth from the left end is: '7'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
